correctness.rationale: Theorem proof details: Tan allowed weights 12/15, two independent 12 words; [17,3,12] violates Griesmer 18; seven-overlap sign algebra forces 2+5+5+5 and exact 1+6z12+2z15. Discriminant linking for negative-definite A2^17 on simply connected quintic resolution identifies H1(smooth locus,F3) dual with cusp code and shows no free/torsion other than F3^2. Every cusp meridian is nonzero, forcing three smooth local lifts in the normalized degree-nine cover; no branch divisor makes K ample of square45. Euler 55-34=21; open part 4, cover 9*4+17*3=87, chi=(45+87)/12=11. Tan q=0 for weight12 and weight15 cyclic intermediate quotients; semisimple G-character decomposition forces q(Y)=0 and pg(Y)=10. The extracted checker exhaustively verifies the 128 sign patterns and finite code spectrum, but the infinite geometry is proved separately.

value.rationale: A natural full cusp code, smooth-locus abelianization and maximal smooth degree-nine quasi-etale covering of a recently constructed six-dimensional family are exact intrinsic geometric invariants. In particular, the ample-canonical surface pg=10, q=0, K2=45 is not the familiar individual 3-fold cover nor the speculative 20-cusp ball quotient; this distinction motivates study of canonical systems and topology of highly cuspidal quintics.
